item.title: New Bayroc Stadium officially opened at Linden
item.description: THE long-awaited Bayroc National Stadium in Linden was officially commissioned on Saturday evening. As part of the opening ceremony, the stadium hosted an Athletics Championship, football match and concert. The Ministry of Culture, Youth and Sport plans to open four other stadiums in 2026. Chronicle Sport will provide further details in a subsequent report.
